sys_hub_trigger_instance_v2.name: Service Catalog

sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Finds the equipment and software items listed on the template.
Logs a Joiner event as In Progress, linked to the user, manager, template and request. This is the audit record.
Raises one fulfilment task per item, assigned to the fulfiller group.
Notifies the manager that the new starter’s account is set up and the fulfilment tasks have been raised.
Finds the groups listed on the template, using a scripted query because the field holds a list.
Sets the event to Partially Complete, because standard access was already granted and only the extra request was refused.
Sends the extra access request to the manager and pauses the flow until they decide.
Creates the account with a lowercase User ID and email built from the name, the manager set and the job title filled in.
Reads the form answers (name, start date, job title, manager, extra access) so later steps can use them.
Adds the new user to the group. Roles then arrive through the group, so access follows membership.
Finds the template that matches the requested job title. It defines the standard access for that role.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Checks whether the manager rejected the request.
Loops through each group the lookup returned.
Checks whether the requester asked for access beyond the template. If not, the flow ends here.
Loops through each item the lookup returned.

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description: Automates onboarding when a New Starter Request is submitted. It looks up the role template for the job title, creates the user account, logs a Joiner event, grants the template’s groups and roles, routes any extra access to the manager for approval, and creates fulfillment tasks for equipment and software.

sys_hub_action_instance_v2.comment: Adds the new user to the group. Roles then arrive through the group, so access follows membership.
Logs a Joiner event as In Progress, linked to the user, manager, template and request. This is the audit record.
Finds the groups listed on the template, using a scripted query because the field holds a list.
Sends the extra access request to the manager and pauses the flow until they decide.
Sets the event to Partially Complete, because standard access was already granted and only the extra request was refused.
Reads the form answers (name, start date, job title, manager, extra access) so later steps can use them.
Finds the equipment and software items listed on the template.
Creates the account with a lowercase User ID and email built from the name, the manager set and the job title filled in.
Notifies the manager that the new starter’s account is set up and the fulfilment tasks have been raised.
Raises one fulfilment task per item, assigned to the fulfiller group.
Finds the template that matches the requested job title. It defines the standard access for that role.

sys_hub_flow_logic_instance_v2.comment: Loops through each group the lookup returned.
Loops through each item the lookup returned.
Checks whether the manager rejected the request.
Checks whether the requester asked for access beyond the template. If not, the flow ends here.
